questions.content: Define ADT Stack and mention its two primary operations along with their function. [2 Marks, L1]
Explain the difference between a Simple Queue and a Circular Queue, with examples. [3 Marks, L2]
Write an algorithm to convert an infix expression to postfix using a stack, and trace it for the expression (A + B) * (C − D). [5 Marks, L3]

For a queue implemented using a simple (linear) array, analyze and compare the time complexity and space utilization of enqueue/dequeue operations versus a circular queue implementation. Explain why they differ. [5 Marks, L4]

A print-job scheduler must always execute high-priority jobs before regular ones, regardless of arrival order. Evaluate whether a Simple Queue is a suitable choice for this, and justify a better alternative if not. [5 Marks, L5] --- End of Assignment ---
